## Implementation
With the backend's new isolated DEV fixture, the existing Notification bell's persistent critical toast was exercised with a real notification. No production app code calls /notifications/test; it is used only by scripts/backend-fix-check.mjs. A system.license socket dispatch fix in electron/main.cjs and src/App.tsx leaves normal notification handling intact. The tested application files include src/screens/Notifications.tsx, src/App.tsx and electron/main.cjs.

Sanitized journal artifacts/backend-fix-passed-20261023.json; screenshots artifacts/backend-license-grace.png, backend-license-grace-ur-250.png, backend-critical-toast.png. Direct authenticated DEV fixture targeted only separately owned synthetic user34 and created critical notification163/category dev.test. Actual WebSocket notification.created event held title/severity/id but no body; the UI fetched the real inbox body, displayed the critical toast past6.2seconds, kept it through navigation and reconnect without duplication, and dismissed it without marking the inbox item read. ## Limits

Named human fresh-data journey, full role FAQ/Urdu review, real licensing transition outside the fixture and whole-screen acceptance remain pending. Proposal grants no points until human review.
